mismatches.question: Is maternity treatment covered from day one of this policy?
mismatches.rationale: Maternity is subject to a 36-month waiting period; it is not covered until that period is served.

mismatches.question: Can I claim for an illness in the first week of the policy?
mismatches.rationale: All illnesses carry an initial 30-day waiting period (except injury-related hospitalisation); cover only attaches after it.

mismatches.question: Are my declared pre-existing conditions covered immediately?
mismatches.rationale: Declared and accepted pre-existing diseases are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage.

mismatches.question: Is there a deductible I must pay before the policy pays a claim?
mismatches.rationale: The policy states the deductible is Not Applicable, so no deductible amount is subtracted before cover applies.
